text:
Which statement about convection is not correct?
A
It enables water in a pan on a cooker to get evenly heated.
B
It happens in liquids and gases.
C
It occurs because cooler liquids rise above warmer liquids.
D
It occurs because the density of a liquid decreases when it is heated.

options.label: A
options.text: It enables water in a pan on a cooker to get evenly heated.

options.label: B
options.text: It happens in liquids and gases.

options.label: C
options.text: It occurs because cooler liquids rise above warmer liquids.

options.label: D
options.text: It occurs because the density of a liquid decreases when it is heated.
